🚀 New Shopify Feature Highlight: “Unlisted” Product Status
Just discovered this gem in Shopify! 💎

The new Unlisted status lets you keep a product hidden from your online store, yet still accessible via a direct link.

Perfect for:

It’s a simple but powerful way to control visibility without juggling custom sales channels or draft products.
